AuditRecord.title: AuditRecord
AuditRecord.description:
A decision from the audit log and, unless it was a rejection, the outbox item it sent or the i-EMS ticket it
raised.

ChunkLocation.title: ChunkLocation
ChunkLocation.description: Where a cited span sits in its document.

GlossaryPayload.description: A change to a business definition: the proposed new version of the term, waiting for the term owner.
GlossaryPayload.title: GlossaryPayload

GlossaryVersion.description: One version of a business term, as the API shows it (a plain mirror of the generated GlossaryTerm).
GlossaryVersion.title: GlossaryVersion

Highlight.title: Highlight
Highlight.description: `blocks[block].text[start:end]` is part of the cited span.

LetterPayload.description: A letter filled from an approved template, as it would be sent.
LetterPayload.title: LetterPayload

MemoryView.title: MemoryView
MemoryView.description: One memory as the officer sees it.

PendingApproval.title: PendingApproval
PendingApproval.description: A pending action and the conversation it waits in.

PiiFinding.description: Personal data that shouldn't be in the draft. Points at the slot; never repeats the value.
PiiFinding.title: PiiFinding

ResumeRequest.title: ResumeRequest
ResumeRequest.description: The officer's decision on the exact pending version of an action.

Submission.title: Submission
Submission.description: An application with a submission bundle, as the Document check screen offers it.

TaskDigest.title: TaskDigest
TaskDigest.description: An officer's top open tasks on `as_of`, ranked by urgency × impact.

ThreadView.title: ThreadView
ThreadView.description: A conversation rebuilt from its checkpoint: every exchange, and the summary standing in for older turns.

TicketPayload.description: An i-EMS ticket for classified feedback, as it would be raised.
TicketPayload.title: TicketPayload

UserCtx.title: UserCtx
UserCtx.description: The signed-in staff member. Approver roles and memory isolation key off this.

ActionResultEvent.description: A decision was carried out: the outbox item sent or i-EMS ticket raised (approve, edit), or nothing (reject).
ActionResultEvent.title: ActionResultEvent

CitationEvent.description: A source the answer cites. `index` is the number of its `[n]` marker in the answer text.
CitationEvent.title: CitationEvent

ClassificationEvent.description: Feedback classified into the defect taxonomy: category, severity, routing team and vendor, confidence, rationale.
ClassificationEvent.title: ClassificationEvent

ConceptUsed.description: A glossary term version a query relied on, with the dates it was in force.
ConceptUsed.title: ConceptUsed

DocCheckEvent.description:
An application's submission bundle checked against its checklist: each file identified, each required
document ticked or crossed, expired, wrong-unit and illegible documents flagged.
DocCheckEvent.title: DocCheckEvent

DraftEvent.description: A letter drafted from an approved template: HTML preview, open slots and personal-data flags. Not sent.
DraftEvent.title: DraftEvent

ErrorEvent.description: The run failed. Any answer streamed so far is partial and must not be trusted.
ErrorEvent.title: ErrorEvent

FileCheck.description: One file of the bundle, identified by what it says rather than its file name.
FileCheck.title: FileCheck

InjectionEvent.description:
A prompt-injection attempt was detected and ignored: instructions planted for the assistant in the officer's
message (nothing else ran) or in a document it read (nothing is proposed this turn). Report it as suspicious.
InjectionEvent.title: InjectionEvent

InterruptEvent.description: The run paused for the officer's decision on this exact version: resume with POST /threads/{id}/resume.
InterruptEvent.title: InterruptEvent

NodeEvent.description: A graph node started or finished, for the trajectory view.
NodeEvent.title: NodeEvent

Override.description: A circular that replaces a clause of one version, possibly only for some units.
Override.title: Override

PolicyStanceEvent.description: PLG's position on one policy: the version in force, the versions it superseded and the circulars overriding it.
PolicyStanceEvent.title: PolicyStanceEvent

ProposedActionEvent.description: Something the assistant proposes to do outside the system. It waits for the officer's decision.
ProposedActionEvent.title: ProposedActionEvent

Span.description: Character offsets into the chunk's text: `text[start:end]` is the cited quote.
Span.title: Span

SqlTraceEvent.description: One query the data agent sent: its plan, SQL, result summary and the glossary terms it relied on.
SqlTraceEvent.title: SqlTraceEvent

TasksEvent.description:
An officer's top open tasks ranked by urgency × impact (a deterministic rules matrix), overdue ones marked,
each with the reasons for its place.
TasksEvent.title: TasksEvent
